mapper.select: /* Attd05Mapper.selectDayList */ WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(#{workYm}, '-', ''), '01'), '%Y%m%d') AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) <= LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(#{workYm}, '-', ''), '01'), '%Y%m%d')) ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') AS workYmd , CASE DAYOFWEEK(d.dt) WHEN 1 THEN '일' WHEN 2 THEN '월' WHEN 3 THEN '화' WHEN 4 THEN '수' WHEN 5 THEN '목' WHEN 6 THEN '금' WHEN 7 THEN '토' END dow , CASE WHEN h.HOLIDAY_YMD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS holidayYn , h.HOLIDAY_NM AS holidayNm , h.HOLIDAY_TYPE AS holidayType , CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.dt) IN (1, 7) -- 1:일요일, 7:토요일 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS weekendYn FROM date_range d LEFT JOIN TB_HOLIDAY h ON h.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND h.HOLIDAY_YMD = d.dt AND h.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* Attd05Mapper.selectSchList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SCH_CD AS schCd , A.SCH_NO AS schNo , CASE WHEN SCH_TYPE = '01' THEN CONCAT( SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 3, 2), '~' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 3, 2)) ELSE CONCAT( SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, 3, 2), '~' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.FST_SCH_END_TIME, 3, 2), '\n' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, 3, 2), '~' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, 1, 2), ':' , SUBSTRING(A.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, 3, 2) ) END schNm FROM TB_SCH_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd}

/* Attd05Mapper.selectLeaveTypeList */ /* prafta-com-011-6 가불 메타: systemYn + balanceDays 를 함께 조회한다(앱 selectApplicableLeaveTypes 미러). - balanceDays 분기(LEAVE_TYPE [SYS021]): · '01'(사용자 신청): IFNULL(MAX_APLY_DAYS,0) − Σ(당해 회계연도 CONFIRMED 사용 LEAVE_DAYS). 회계연도 경계 [fiscalStartYmd, fiscalEndYmdExclusive) 는 서비스가 FiscalYearUtils 로 산출해 주입. · 그 외(시스템 법정 월차/본연차 포함, LEAVE_TYPE='02'): IFNULL(Σ(GRANT_DAYS) − Σ(USED_DAYS), 0). - 가불 산정 필드(borrowable/borrowQuota/borrowExpiryYmd)는 엔진 projection 이라 SQL 이 NULL 로 채우고 서비스가 시스템 법정 월차/본연차에 한해 재산정한다(record 매핑을 위해 컬럼은 모두 SELECT). */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , A.LEAVE_NO AS leaveNo , A.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , A.LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType , A.APRV_USE_YN AS aprvUseYn , A.LEAVE_NATURE_TYPE AS leaveNatureType , A.SYSTEM_YN AS systemYn , CASE WHEN A.LEAVE_TYPE = '01' THEN IFNULL(A.MAX_APLY_DAYS, 0) - IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(U.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = #{gvUserCd} AND U.LEAVE_CD = A.LEAVE_CD AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.START_DATE >= #{fiscalStartYmd} AND U.START_DATE < #{fiscalEndYmdExclusive} ), 0) ELSE IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) - SUM(G.USED_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = #{gvUserCd} AND G.LEAVE_CD = A.LEAVE_CD AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.EXPIRE_YN = 'N' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' ), 0) END AS balanceDays , NULL AS borrowable , NULL AS borrowQuota , NULL AS borrowExpiryYmd FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SYSTEM_YN DESC, A.LEAVE_NO ASC, A.LEAVE_CD ASC

/* Attd05Mapper.deleteUserWorkPlans */ /* prafta-com-013-04-1: 월 단위 일괄 삭제도 연차 등록일은 건너뛴다(셀 비우기 보호와 대칭). 종일 확정 연차(leave_use)가 덮인 날짜의 work_plan 행은 삭제 대상에서 제외한다. 판정 술어는 셀 비우기(selectFullDayLeaveCdOnCell)·그리드 오버레이(selectLeaveOverlayList)와 동일: USE_UNIT_TYPE='00', LEAVE_STATUS='CONFIRMED', DEL_YN='N', START_DATE ~ END_DATE 구간에 WORK_YMD 포함. 연차 취소는 attd13 동의흐름을 경유하므로(전면 동의 원칙) 여기서는 삭제하지 않는다.
prafta-com-016-C-3: 초과근무(OT) 등록/신청 보유일도 삭제 대상에서 제외(부분 삭제). OT 는 스케줄 기준으로 정산되므로 보유일의 스케줄 삭제를 막는다. 판정 술어는 countDayOvertime/ countMonthOvertime 과 동일(등록 비취소 ∪ 신청 03/04 상태 01/02). WORK_YMD(YYYYMMDD)는 같은 일자로 직접 비교하므로 기존 countMonthOvertime 의 LEFT(...,6)=workYm 포맷 버그와 무관하다. */ DELETE FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP WHERE WP.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND WP.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD LIKE CONCAT(replace(#{workYm},'-', ''), '%') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = WP.USER_CD AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '00' AND U.START_DATE <= WP.WORK_YMD AND U.END_DATE >= WP.WORK_YMD ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_OVERTIME_MGMT OM WHERE OM.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND OM.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND OM.USER_CD = WP.USER_CD AND OM.WORK_YMD = WP.WORK_YMD AND OM.DEL_YN = 'N' AND OM.OT_STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ RQ WHERE RQ.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND RQ.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND RQ.USER_CD = WP.USER_CD AND RQ.WORK_YMD = WP.WORK_YMD AND RQ.DEL_YN = 'N' AND RQ.REQ_TYPE IN ('03', '04') AND RQ.REQ_STATUS IN ('01', '02') )
